summary: Tested new admin manual vehicle checkout feature (POST /api/admin/vehicles/{vehicle_id}/checkout). All 10 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified checkout button on vehicle cards, inline confirmation flow, and success toast. Both admin and valet dashboards working correctly.

Backend: POST /api/admin/vehicles/{vehicle_id}/checkout returns 403 for valet role
Backend: POST /api/admin/vehicles/{vehicle_id}/checkout allowed for admin role (404 for non-existent)
Backend: POST /api/admin/vehicles/{vehicle_id}/checkout allowed for super_admin role
Backend: POST /api/admin/vehicles/{vehicle_id}/checkout returns 404 for non-existent vehicle
Backend: POST /api/admin/vehicles/{vehicle_id}/checkout successfully checks out parked vehicle
Backend: POST /api/admin/vehicles/{vehicle_id}/checkout creates completed ticket for record-keeping
Backend: POST /api/admin/vehicles/{vehicle_id}/checkout handles existing active ticket (completes it)
Backend: GET /api/admin/dashboard-stats returns correct structure
Backend: GET /api/valet/dashboard-stats returns correct structure
Frontend: Admin stat cards (card-active-valets, card-vehicles, card-tips) visible for admin
Frontend: Vehicles modal opens when clicking card-vehicles
Frontend: Checkout button (checkout-button-{id}) appears on each vehicle card
Frontend: Clicking Checkout shows inline confirmation with Confirm/Cancel buttons
Frontend: checkout-confirm-{id} button found
Frontend: checkout-cancel-{id} button found
Frontend: Clicking Confirm triggers checkout and shows success toast

Frontend: FAB toggle works with Park/Retrieve buttons for both roles
seed_data_creation: Created test vehicles during backend testing with unique phone numbers and license plates
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin manual vehicle checkout feature is fully working. Key data-testids: checkout-button-{id} (on each vehicle card in modal), checkout-confirm-{id} (green confirm button), checkout-cancel-{id} (cancel button). The checkout flow: 1) Admin clicks card-vehicles to open modal, 2) Clicks Checkout button on a vehicle, 3) Inline confirmation appears with Confirm/Cancel, 4) Clicking Confirm calls POST /api/admin/vehicles/{id}/checkout, 5) Success toast appears and vehicle is marked as checked_out. WhatsApp thank-you message is sent (Twilio configured but in sandbox mode). Tips data shows 0 as Razorpay is not configured (MOCKED).
